title: Cadence Instrument Pack
description: Data-driven synthesis preset pack for Cadence (schema_version 1). Pure JSON, no code, no samples. Rust validation in src/packs.rs is authoritative and rejects unknown fields; this schema mirrors it for editors and cheap AI generation.

schema_version.description: Pack format version. Only 1 is supported.

id.description: Pack id slug: lowercase a-z, 0-9, '-', '_' and '.', no leading/trailing '.' or '..'. Becomes the installed file name <id>.json.
Namespaced instrument id slug, e.g. eight-bit.pulse-lead. Unique across all loaded packs; first definition wins.

oscillators.description: 1-4 oscillators. Required for melodic presets; may be omitted entirely when `kit` is present (any listed oscillators are still validated, but inert).

pitch_envelope.description: Optional pitch sweep: starts `amount_semitones` sharp/flat and decays exponentially to zero after note-on. `decay` is T60 (0.001 of the offset remains at that time).

filter_envelope.description: Optional filter sweep in log2 cutoff space: `amount_octaves` is added to the base cutoff and decays exponentially to zero (T60). Negative amounts start darker and open toward the base cutoff.

filter_resonance.description: Resonance of the low-pass filter, normalized 0..0.95 and mapped to a safe filter Q. 0 = the legacy flat response.

lfo.description: Optional free-running LFO (unsynced Hz, deterministic from note-on) modulating pitch, filter cutoff and/or tremolo depth.

bit_depth.description: Bitcrush depth. 24 = full quality; 4-8 gives lo-fi grit.

sample_hold.description: Sample-and-hold interval in samples. 1 = off; higher values add aliasing grit.

audition_note.description: MIDI note the library preview/audition centres on. Preview metadata only; never affects the rendered signal.

audition_duration.description: Seconds the library preview/audition holds the note. Preview metadata only; never affects the rendered signal.

kit.description: Optional drum kit: an ordered list of named one-shot voices, each mapped to a MIDI pitch. When present the preset plays as a kit — note-on picks the piece with the nearest pitch (exact match wins, ties go to the lower pitch) — and the top-level synthesis fields become inert metadata that is still range-validated when present. Pair with the drum editor in the app.

pieces.description: Ordered piece list; array order is the kit's display/row order. Piece pitches must be unique (0-127).

pitch.description: MIDI pitch this piece answers to. Must be unique within the kit; unmapped notes play the nearest piece.

oscillators.description: 1-4 oscillators; required (a voice with none fails validation, like a melodic preset).

filter_resonance.description: Resonance of the low-pass filter, normalized 0..0.95.

bit_depth.description: Bitcrush depth. 24 = full quality; 4-8 gives lo-fi grit.

sample_hold.description: Sample-and-hold interval in samples. 1 = off; higher values add aliasing grit.

kitVoice.description: Synthesis fields of one kit piece — identical shapes, ranges and defaults to the melodic fields of a preset (no id/name/monophonic/audition). All fields optional with defaults; `oscillators` must contain 1-4 entries.

frequency_ratio.description: Frequency multiplier vs the played note. 0.5 = octave down, 2.0 = octave up, 4.0 = two octaves.

pulse_width.description: Fraction of the cycle the pulse stays high (0.5 = 50% duty). Only used by the pulse waveform.

decay.description: Optional per-layer T60 fade in seconds after note-on, on top of the global envelope. Omit or null for a constant layer level. Useful for short noise clicks vs longer tails.

envelope.description: Times in seconds; sustain is a 0..1 level.

pitchEnvelope.description: Pitch offset in semitones decaying exponentially to zero after note-on; `decay` is T60.

filterEnvelope.description: Filter cutoff offset in octaves (log2 space) decaying exponentially to the base cutoff; `decay` is T60.

lfo.description: Free-running LFO starting deterministically at note-on. Pitch/filter depths are bipolar; `amplitude` is tremolo depth and never amplifies the signal.
